```yaml
name: Remove Experimental Decorators

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 1 * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  remove-decorators:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Run decorator removal script
        id: run_script
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          SCRIPT_EXIT_CODE=0
          python dev/remove_experimental_decorators.py || SCRIPT_EXIT_CODE=$?
          if [ $SCRIPT_EXIT_CODE -ne 0 ]; then
            echo "Script failed with exit code $SCRIPT_EXIT_CODE" >&2
            exit $SCRIPT_EXIT_CODE
          fi

      - name: Check for changes
        id: changes
        shell: bash
        run: |
          if git diff --quiet; then
            echo "no_changes=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "no_changes=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Create branch and commit changes
        id: create_branch
        if: steps.changes.outputs.no_changes == 'false'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          TIMESTAMP=$(date +%Y-%m-%d-%H-%M-%S)
          BRANCH="automated/remove-experimental-decorators-$TIMESTAMP"
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git checkout -b $BRANCH
          git add -A
          git commit -m "Remove experimental decorators"
          git push -u origin $BRANCH
          echo "branch=$BRANCH" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Create PR
        if: steps.changes.outputs.no_changes == 'false'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          cat <<'EOF' > /tmp/pr_body.txt
          This PR removes experimental decorators from the codebase.
          The changes were automatically generated by the monthly workflow.
          EOF
          gh pr create \
            --title "Remove experimental decorators" \
            --body-file /tmp/pr_body.txt \
            --label automated \
            --head ${{ steps.create_branch.outputs.branch }} \
            --base main
```
